title: Microfluidic Single-Cell Bioanalysis for Decoding Tumor Heterogeneity.
snippet: Tumor heterogeneity drives cancer progression, dissemination, therapeutic adaptation, and relapse, yet many clinically relevant cell states are rare, transient, context-dependent, and obscured by population-averaged analysis.
